panels.description: Bi11bot projects a clean holographic mountain cross-section: Keel, Halyard and Oasis with three distinct unlettered markers. Only the Keel marker glows amber. Leave upper corners clear; generate no labels or text.
The bright unlettered Keel marker sits beneath the sealed mine entrance. Leave upper-left clear for lettering.
Alex studies the sealed mine marker while Bi11bot stands beside him. Leave upper corners clear.
Alex looks toward the workbench where Adrian’s hologram stood, holding the creased photograph. Bi11bot remains beside him. Leave upper corners clear.
Alex turns Adrian’s watch over while Bi11bot’s eye rings click toward him. Leave upper corners clear.

Alex presses his hand to the unlettered Keel marker. A thin amber line leaves the map and enters an existing infrastructure route, clearly reading as a simple Legacy Protocol alert transmission, not artifact activation or authority transfer. Leave lower-left open.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Your father left a trail. Three artifacts, in three places.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: He called it the Legacy Protocol.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: The first is called the Measure. It's somewhere inside the old mine.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: That mine's been sealed since before I was born.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: You don't need to. This one is under your feet.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: And finding it tells me what happened to him?

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: It tells us where he wanted you to begin. The rest, we'll have to discover.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Everyone says he gambled it all away.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: That's a theory. The mine is evidence.
